text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, I saw Hishi Amazon and 
Fuji Kiseki at the cafe and approached 
them—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you sure can eat. Is that your 
fourth slice of cake?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to fail today's makeup 
exam! I've gotta eat way more to fuel up.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Just let me know if you need more, okay? 
I'll keep bringing them over!"
choice_data_list:
Do makeup exams have anything to do with 
cake?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it isn't the Trainer! Glad you 
asked!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
choice_data_list: Eat up and do your best on the test!
Eat plenty and do your best on the test!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
choice_data_list: Eat up and do your best on the test!
Eat plenty and do your best on the test!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, sweet things serve as fuel to keep 
your brain running, right?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Then it's better to eat a lot... Right, 
Fuji?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the more fuel the better, of course. 
Well, eating too much can make you sleepy, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Fuji... Are you finding this amusing by 
any chance?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"No way! I just thought Hishiama could 
power through both the drowsiness and the 
retake exam with pure spirit!"
choice_data_list: Moderation is best in all things.

Moderation is best in all things, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If you say so, Trainer-boy, I 
suppose I'll call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you really trust your Trainer a lot, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
As long as we work together, trust will 
come naturally.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Here, Trainie, you eat the last one!

After getting a suitable amount of sugar, 
Hishi Amazon eagerly threw herself into 
studying for the makeup exam.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, leave it to me! I'll knock 
history and math flat on their backs 
together!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"That's the spirit! I'll go get us some 
more cake, then."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Since we're celebrating, I'll have them 
prepare a whole cake♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on! I'll eat till I burst and 
take on the test in peak condition!

After stuffing herself with cake while 
studying, Hishi Amazon headed off to take 
her makeup exam...
